headline: Milei seeks approval for trade agreement with the US in December
summary: Argentina's government wants the Agreement on Reciprocal Trade and Investment (ARTI) added to the extraordinary sessions in December. The aim is to avoid a delay until 2027.
why: A reciprocal trade agreement with the United States would set tariff and investment terms between Argentina's and the world's largest economy, affecting exporters and foreign investors.
original_headline: Milei busca aval para acuerdo comercial con EU en diciembre
